column3: “this wretched place” renders “this evil place,” and “grain” renders “seed.”
“came forth abundantly” renders “many waters came forth.”
“a long time” renders “many days,” and “the Egyptians” renders “Egypt.”
“the king’s highway” renders “the way of the king.”
“nothing else” renders “there is nothing (it is no matter).”
“to his people” renders “to his peoples (kinsmen),” and “My command” renders “my mouth.”
